fields.name: the project or contract title
fields.reference_number: the owner's tender, bid or contract number
fields.scope_of_work: a summary of the work to be done
fields.delivery_method: how the contractor is paid for the whole work: lump_sum = one fixed price for all of it; unit_price = unit rates times measured quantities for all of it; mixed = some items at a lump sum and others at unit rates, the usual case for a schedule of quantities. A clause naming "the lump sum price" of one item, or of the bid for a bond, does not make the whole contract lump_sum
fields.currency: the currency of the bid prices
fields.timezone: the timezone of the project location; it is right when it is the timezone of the place the source text names, even when the text does not name a timezone
fields.closing_date: when bids are due: a date and time, or the document's own wording when it states the deadline another way
fields.start_date: when the work starts: a date, or the document's own wording when the start is relative ("on notification to commence work", "10 days after award"). A time allowed to finish the work ("within 120 calendar days of notification") is the completion date, not the start
fields.completion_date: when the work must be complete: a date, or the document's own wording when it is a period ("120 calendar days of notification to commence work")
fields.inquiry_deadline: when bidder questions must be in: a date, or the document's own wording when it is relative ("four working days prior to closing")
fields.submission_url: the web address where bids are submitted
fields.location: where the work is: the site, road or area where it is built, not the address of the owner's, consultant's or bidders' office
fields.liquidated_damages: what the contractor pays per period of delay
fields.bid_validity_days: how many days a bid stays irrevocable and open for acceptance after closing, as a number of days
fields.taxes: whether bid prices include sales taxes (GST, HST, PST, sales tax): included, excluded, or some included and others not, and which taxes
fields.contract_form: the standard form of contract or general conditions the work is let under, with its edition: CCDC 2, MMCD, AIA A101, EJCDC, OPSS or a municipal standard
fields.prevailing_wage: a wage schedule the contractor must pay: prevailing wage, Davis-Bacon, a fair wage policy or a union rate schedule
fields.substitution_deadline: when requests to use a substitute or equal product must be in: a date, or the document's own wording

lists.alternates: a price asked for beside the base bid: an alternate (an add or deduct option) or a separate price for part of the work; not a base-bid line and not an owner allowance
lists.price_adjustments: a clause that adjusts the contract price with a cost index: fuel, asphalt cement, steel or another material
lists.separate_contracts: a separate contract, lot or part of the work bid or awarded on its own
lists.participation_goals: a participation goal the bidder must meet or report: DBE, MBE, WBE, local hiring, Indigenous or social procurement, with its percentage
lists.bonds: a bond the bidder must provide: bid bond, performance bond, labour and material bond or maintenance bond
lists.insurance: insurance the contractor must carry: commercial general liability, auto liability, non-owned auto liability, professional liability, errors and omissions, pollution liability, builder's risk, an installation floater, workers' compensation or umbrella, with its limit
lists.requirements: a contract term that binds the contractor for the whole contract and affects price or risk: the warranty or maintenance period; a safety programme or prime contractor duties; a law, regulation, permit regime or named standard the contract makes the contractor comply with; holdback and its release; how and when the contractor is paid. A technical specification of materials, dimensions, methods, tests or markings is not a requirement, and a rule for how the bid is priced (currency, items to price, taxes) is a bid-submission condition
lists.conditions: a step a bidder must complete, or a qualification it must hold, for its bid to be accepted or the contract to be signed, one step per entry, at one or more stages: eligibility (what the bidder must be or hold before bidding: prequalification, an invited list, plan-taker registration, a licence, experience, bonding capacity, a certificate held at closing, obtaining the standard documents), bid submission (what must be in the bid: the signed form, bid security, forms, declarations, a subcontractor list, a schedule or work plan; and how the bid is priced: the currency, every item priced, optional work priced, whether taxes are included in the bid prices; tax registration and invoicing after award are payment terms), bidding period (a rule to follow before closing: a mandatory meeting or site visit, keeping the bid open for the stated days) or award (what the successful bidder delivers or does after award and before the contract is signed: the bonds, insurance proof, a clearance letter, a baseline schedule, signing). A bond or policy is named only as a document to deliver, without its amount or terms. Not a condition: anything after the contract is signed (starting work, a notice to proceed, permits, coordination, seasonal limits), a bidder's right (to revoke or ask questions), how the work is done, how the contractor is paid (actual quantities times unit prices, which is a payment term), or a date with its own field (closing, questions deadline, completion)
lists.obligations: something the contractor must do after the contract is signed, one action per entry: before work starts (a notice to proceed, a permit, a plan or submittal due before starting), during the work (coordination with a third party, when or where work may happen, testing or inspection it arranges, reports or notices) or at closeout (as-built records, final documents). Not a material, dimension or method the specification sets
lists.events: a meeting for bidders before close (a pre-bid meeting, on site or not) or an unaccompanied site visit
lists.parties: an organisation or person involved in the bid: owner, consultant, designer, contractor, subcontractor, surety or legal, with its contact person

entry_types.bonds.bid_bond: bid security: a bid bond, certified cheque or bank draft submitted with the bid
entry_types.bonds.performance_bond: a performance bond from the successful bidder
entry_types.bonds.labour_material_bond: a labour and material payment bond
entry_types.insurance.auto_liability: automobile liability insurance for owned, leased or hired vehicles
entry_types.insurance.non_owned_auto: non-owned automobile liability insurance, for vehicles the contractor does not own
entry_types.insurance.professional_liability: professional liability insurance, named as such
entry_types.insurance.errors_omissions: errors and omissions insurance, named as its own policy
entry_types.insurance.pollution_liability: pollution liability insurance: contractor's pollution liability, environmental impairment liability, or gradual and sudden pollution coverage
entry_types.insurance.installation_floater: an installation or materials-in-transit floater covering the materials being installed, as its own policy
entry_types.insurance.equipment_floater: a contractor's equipment floater covering the contractor's own equipment and machinery
entry_types.insurance.workers_comp: a workers' compensation insurance policy with a stated coverage limit, not a clearance certificate or proof of good standing
entry_types.requirements.warranty: a warranty or maintenance period the contractor gives on the work
entry_types.requirements.safety: a safety obligation of the contractor: a safety plan, prime contractor duties or OHS compliance
entry_types.requirements.compliance: a law, code or standard the work must comply with, including a WSIB or workers' compensation clearance certificate or proof of good standing
entry_types.requirements.holdback: a holdback or retainage withheld from payments
entry_types.requirements.payment_terms: how or when the contractor is paid: progress payments, the payment period or invoicing
entry_types.conditions.eligibility: a condition of who may bid: prequalification, an invited list, a licence, registration, experience, bonding capacity or a certification the bidder must hold
entry_types.conditions.bid_submission: something that must be submitted with the bid, or a rule for how the bid is priced
entry_types.conditions.bidding_period: a rule of the bidding period: a mandatory meeting or site visit, or how long bids stay irrevocable
entry_types.conditions.award: something the successful bidder delivers or does after award and before the contract is signed
entry_types.alternates.alternate: an alternate: an add or deduct option priced beside the base bid
entry_types.alternates.separate_price: a separate price asked for part of the work, beside the base bid
entry_types.obligations.before_start: something the contractor must do after the contract is signed and before work starts
entry_types.obligations.during_work: something the contractor must do while the work goes on
entry_types.obligations.closeout: something the contractor must deliver or do at completion
entry_types.obligations.permit: a permit or approval the contractor must obtain
entry_types.obligations.submittal: a plan, schedule, data or document the contractor must submit
entry_types.obligations.notice: a notice the contractor must give or act on
entry_types.obligations.coordination: work the contractor must coordinate with a third party
entry_types.obligations.site_constraint: a limit on when or where work may happen
entry_types.obligations.testing: tests or inspections the contractor must arrange or pay for
entry_types.obligations.reporting: records or reports the contractor must keep or give during the work
entry_types.events.site_visit: an unaccompanied or self-guided visit of the site by bidders, with no meeting
entry_types.events.pre_bid_meeting: any meeting held for bidders before close, on site or not (a site meeting, pre-tender meeting or bidders' tour)
entry_types.parties.consultant: the consultant, engineer or contract administrator
entry_types.parties.contractor: a contractor other than the bidders, such as a prime contractor
entry_types.parties.legal: a legal adviser or solicitor for the tender
entry_types.insurance.wrap_up_liability: a project wrap-up liability policy: wrap-up, OCIP, CCIP or project-specific liability
entry_types.insurance.boiler_machinery: boiler and machinery or equipment breakdown, including testing and commissioning
entry_types.insurance.aircraft_watercraft: liability for owned or non-owned manned aircraft or watercraft, including aircraft passenger hazard
entry_types.insurance.unmanned_aircraft: drone or unmanned aerial vehicle liability
entry_types.insurance.crane_liability: hook, on-hook, crane, hoist or riggers liability: property while it is lifted or rigged
entry_types.insurance.railway_protective: railway or railroad protective liability for work on or near a railway
entry_types.insurance.property: property insurance on the contractor's own property or property in its care, not on the work
entry_types.insurance.other: a required policy none of these types describes
